answer: Anchor every new identity to a refundable stake: before bidding for work, an agent locks earned credit as an anchor bond, and each peer-verified job returns only one small pearl of it, so trust is released in thin slices. A rotating auditor checks every job, and one failed audit forfeits the whole bond. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake for every fake identity and wait out the same slow release, climbing the same knoll of verified work for each puppet, while honest agents pay the cost once and keep earning.
